subject: QBR: resources escrow proposal + priority decisions for pending reqs
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Leadership Team <leadership@redwood.ai>; Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>; Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: QBR: resources escrow proposal + priority decisions for pending reqs

Team —

As we finalize QBR materials, a recurring ask from Sales and Product is more clarity on which open headcount reqs get immediate approval vs. which are held for the hiring freeze we're projecting for early Q1. To make decisions faster and reduce repeated escalations, I'd like to pilot a "resources escrow" process for the remainder of FY26: we earmark budget for a small set of high-impact backfills/critical hires, approve them now in principle, and then complete formal onboarding/req steps once Workday/Finance gates are satisfied.

Attached: QBR_hiring_pack.pdf (overview of 12 active reqs, rough TTM, and one-page impact notes).

Quick summary:
- Total open reqs in scope: 12 (Engineering, Product, Customer Success)
- Proposed escrow slots: 3 (two backfills, one growth hire)
- Candidate for immediate approval (in my opinion): Eng Backend Sr. IC (req# REQ-4281), CS Escalations Lead (backfill), Product Data PM (growth)

Decision asks (quick):
1) Confirm which roles leadership signs off to place in escrow (names above are my nominations).
2) Any objections to a temporary freeze for non-customer-facing growth headcount until after Q1 results are in?
3) If we approve escrow slots, who will be responsible for completing Workday requisitions and driving expedited offers?

I'll collect responses by EOD Wednesday so we can include final guidance in the QBR packet.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Chief of Staff, People & Operations
Redwood Inference

---
(Attachment: QBR_hiring_pack.pdf)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>; Leadership Team <leadership@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR: resources escrow proposal + priority decisions for pending reqs

+1 to the escrow idea — we need a lightweight mechanism to avoid repeated ad-hoc approvals during QBR prep. My reading of the attached pack: two of the engineering reqs are clearly critical (backend infra backfill, realtime KV cache owner). I propose:

- Escrow slot A: Backend Senior IC (REQ-4281) — replace ASAP, high customer impact if unfilled.
- Escrow slot B: Realtime KV cache owner (internal replacement) — priority medium-high.

Operational ask: If approved, I can own expedited interviews next week and commit to offer within two weeks for internal candidates. Finance should confirm budget hold for these two slots.

On the freeze: endorse temporary freeze for non-customer-facing hires; product-facing and platform stability hires should be exempt.

-Markus
VP Engineering

Thanks for pulling this together. From Product's side, we should protect customer-facing roles and any headcount tied to committed roadmap deliveries. That said, I recommend we hold non-customer-facing growth and exploratory PD hires until after Q1 close.

Specifics:
- Approve escrow for:
  * CS Escalations Lead (backfill) — immediate customer ROI, high priority
  * Backend Senior IC (REQ-4281) — as Markus called out
- Do not approve escrow for Product Data PM (growth) at this time — deprioritize until after Q1

Subject: Re: QBR: resources escrow proposal + priority decisions for pending reqs

Team —

Quick capacity and budget note from infra: we have constrained GPU-related spend in Nov–Dec due to data center lease trimming; approving two engineering seats now will consume the remaining headroom on the reserved Q4 commit unless we reclassify one slot from growth to operational. Numbers below (very rough):

- Backend Senior IC (REQ-4281): incremental monthly cost (salary + bench) ~ $32k
- Realtime KV owner: incremental monthly cost ~ $28k

If leadership approves both escrow slots today, Finance to place a budget hold against the Q4 commit (Finance — can you confirm via reply?).

I recommend we:
- Approve the two operational slots (Backend Senior IC + CS Escalations Lead)
- Delay the growth SKU (Product Data PM)

Will support hiring timeline and provide interview paneling.

— Karthik
Head of Infrastructure & Capacity

Thanks everyone — consolidating decisions here so the QBR packet reflects a single leadership ask/answer: 

Final leadership guidance: (approved today)
- Escrow approvals granted for: 
  1) Backend Senior IC (REQ-4281) — owner: Markus (expedite internal candidates)
  2) CS Escalations Lead (backfill) — owner: Vanessa (CS lead to move offer pipeline)
- Product Data PM (growth) remains paused for Q1; revisit in Feb.

Operational next steps (owners + deadlines):
- Finance to place budget hold on two approved slots by EOD Fri 10/23. (Finance ticket will be created.)
- Hiring owners to open expedited Workday requisitions and route for fast-track approvals: https://workday.company.com/requisition/REQ-4281
- People Ops (Tessa) to prepare expedited offer template and checklist; target offers within two weeks of candidate selection.
- Hannah to include an "escrow summary" slide in the QBR deck and note approvals.

If anyone needs an escape-hatch for a later critical exception, use the DocuSign escape-hatch approval form linked below (requires exec sponsor): https://docusign.net/link/escape-hatch-approval

I'll mark this resolved for the QBR. Thanks for quick replies.

Lauren Bishop
